source_checks.notes: Correct distinction between optimizer/scorer roles and accuracy scoring; 71.8 to 80.2 is 8.4 percentage points and approximately 11.7 percent relative; historical setup and validation-set caveat are explicit.

Fixed underlying weights, reflective prompt updates, instance-wise winner union, dominance pruning, and frequency-weighted parent selection agree with the paper. Ordinary nondominance is correctly distinguished. AIME counterexample and limited scope of the GRPO comparison are retained.

Memory state and code design are distinct; collection/static/dynamic roles are correct. Table 1 uses three-run standard errors. Printed means, percentage-point deltas, the Baba Is AI counterexample, and rounding caveats are accurate.

Frozen model and own-code modification, archive maximum versus mean, staged evaluation, 200-task SWE-bench Verified subset, separate Polyglot subset/full results, empirical rather than proof-based improvement, and fixed outer exploration process are correctly bounded.

Notation is introduced locally. The binary loss identity, validation-based selection, held-out arithmetic, execution count, GEPA candidate probabilities, memory update/retrieval abstraction, and fixed-score archive inequality are correct under the stated assumptions.

The stored captions support the linked NTU and GEPA ICLR passage ranges. Paper revision dates are not presented as all papers first being published in 2026. Stanford 2025 slides and the ICLR 2026 talk are identified as separate presentations.

primary_source_files.checked_sections: sections 3 and 4.1-4.4; Figures 2-4; Appendix E.2 and E.4

limitations: This is a source-and-arithmetic review, not an independent reproduction of any paper experiment.
No LLM training, prompt search, memory-design search, DGM run, or benchmark execution was performed.
Video checks used the archived caption segments; audio was not independently transcribed or listened to in this review.
No claim is made that source papers establish universal performance improvements or statistical significance beyond their reported conditions.
This review did not perform final rendered-site layout, mobile, link-availability, or deployment checks.
The findings bind to the recorded article SHA256; subsequent article edits require matching or refreshing this review.
